designDecisions: THE 'mixed' BRANCH IS THE SEAM (§5.1; lidResponse.js:230-234). V2-2a left an explicit return-marker at the 'mixed'/'off-pilot' default branch (carrier.height UNWRITTEN, {unimplemented:true}) with the comment 'V2-2b swaps real mixed machinery in HERE'. V2-2b-2a replaces the 'mixed' arm with the real composition: it WRITES carrier.height (REPLACE) via a new three-free mixed-interior composer, returns the multi-valued primitiveId + centerId + a mixedDiag, and leaves 'off-pilot' still a marker. The composer MAY be factored into a NEW three-free src/worldengine/base/ helper (e.g. mixedInterior.js) imported by lidResponse.js, or inlined — a build-plan call; either way it takes no cross-imports beyond alea/simplex/mathutil and the corner writers' expression kernels are NOT re-entered (the mixed path is its own composition over a shared center set, not a call into writeMagmatismSphere/writeStagnantLidReliefSphere). The two PURE corners (pure-weak/pure-strong) are untouched — byte-identity is structural (different branch).

PROVINCE-DISCRETE EXPRESSION IS THE ANTI-MUSH MECHANISM (§2.1). Mixing happens at the level of WHICH landform each upwelling center grows, NEVER by blending heightfields. A mid-axis world is not '50% shield + 50% corona everywhere'; it is 'these strong centers pierced as shields, these weaker ones tented into coronae, this cluster thickened into tessera, the lows flooded to a plains datum.' Each node's height derives from EXACTLY ONE primitive (AC-MIX-DISCRETE); only WITHIN a province is anything continuous (bounded-continuous texture, strictly below province-floor gaps). The three transition types (§2.4): SHARP where the science is sharp (per-center pierce boolean, no blend); BOUNDED-CONTINUOUS inside a province only; SEEDED-MULTISTABLE upstream in E1 (the composer receives a RESOLVED E1 coordinate, never a blend).

PER-CENTER PIERCE = SHARP BOOLEAN (gate-2 / §2.4 / delegable #2). For each seeded center p: PIERCE iff plumeStrength_p·Φ > Ybase(L), where Ybase(L) = Y0·exp(Y_K·L) (gate-2's calibrated form; Y0/Y_K are first-cut UAT-tunable constants, mirroring #4-M's K_* and V2-2b-1's K_* — the AC asserts the correct SIGN + gate-2's calibrated pierce COUNTS at pinned vectors, not a frozen gain). Strong L → few/no pierce (Tharsis: 1-3 of the strongest exceed local yield on a preserved datum); weaker L / higher Φ → more pierce. The boolean is the anti-mush lynchpin: a center is a shield OR it is not, no partial-pierce blend. Pierced centers grow the magma shield/caldera curve (PIERCE family); un-pierced strong-lid centers grow coronae/tessera (TENT family); lows flood to a plains datum; extension between neighbours = analytic rift arc.

NEW ABSOLUTE-DATUM PROVINCE STACK + EDIFICE BUDGET BOUND (§2.4 D1-MF1 fix / delegable #7 / AC-ORDER-MIX). The mixed-interior ordering is a NEW mechanism (NOT the corners' code paths — no constant-gap stack reproduces magma's adaptive flood datum AND stagnant's constant floors bit-for-bit; byte-identity is scoped to the two corners via preserved paths, §2.3 D1-MF1). It is an absolute-datum stack with its OWN legibility ACs: mean(tessera) > mean(plains) > mean(rift) AND edifice > plain > basin, with a budget bound that caps the shield-edifice HEIGHT contribution BELOW the inter-province floor gaps — CRITICALLY including magma's tall edifices (up to EDIFICE_HEIGHT=1.0), not just stagnant texture (the previous 0.24<0.60 bound covered only stagnant texture and left magma edifices unbounded — the exact mush the design defeats). No landform can climb over another's floor.

primitiveId MULTI-VALUED + centerId CO-EMIT + Π=C·F STATISTIC (gate-3 Open-Q1/Q2/Q3/Q6; §5.3 AC-MIX-DISCRETE + AC-INTERPEN). The composer POPULATES the per-node primitiveId Int32Array with the true multi-valued mix (V2-2a filled it uniformly on the single-family corners) using the PRIMITIVE_ID enum already exported by lidResponse.js (shield/caldera/patera/lava-plain = PIERCE 1-4; corona/tessera/rift/stagnant-basaltic-plain = TENT 5-8), and CO-EMITS a per-node centerId (which upwelling center owns the node). The Π=C·F interpenetration statistic (C = cross-family co-occurrence, F = family contrast, per gate-3) + its companion M≤0.70 guard is IMPLEMENTED reading primitiveId + familyOf (adjacency-component-based; centerId is co-emitted for the probe/2b-2b, NOT consumed by the statistic) and VALIDATED to reproduce gate-3's 100%/0% separation over the committed synthetic worlds × 2 meshes. SCOPE FENCE: 2b-2a builds + validates the INSTRUMENT and confirms it runs non-trivially on Tharsis (which carries PIERCE shields among TENT provinces); the FALSIFICATION-grade claim ('pierce and tent INTERPENETRATE rather than tile into separable Io-patch/Venus-patch regions') is 2b-2b's corona-pierced test, not asserted here.

FIRST 'lid:' ALEA DRAWS — NAMESPACE GOES LIVE (§5.3 AC1; reconciles the V2-2a/V2-2b-1 reserved-namespace guard). The composer is the FIRST code to draw in the 'lid:' alea namespace (e.g. 'lid:centers:'/'lid:pierce:'/'lid:texture:'), which V2-2a and V2-2b-1 asserted had ZERO draws (tests/worldengine-lid-router-audit.test.js). That audit is RECONCILED (not removed): 'lid:' draws are now PERMITTED, but ONLY in the mixed composer / mixed path — the two pure corners still make ZERO 'lid:' draws, so corner byte-identity holds. Zero Math.random/Date.now; the composer is a pure function of (E1 coordinate, macroSeed) → byte-identical carrier.height + primitiveId + centerId + diag on repeat builds (fixed draw order, bounded fixed relax passes, render-once).

TharSIS = HAND-SET D-VECTOR, NO SEEDED PICK, NO effectiveL (§5.4 #3 / R-marspreset). Tharsis has no preset until V2-3, so AC-THARSIS drives a hand-set E1 coordinate (strong L, low Φ, low n, tidally quiet → rawTidal<SHOULDER_LO so it classifies 'mixed' via cut #5, the mixed interior [MIXED_LO, L_STRONG)). It uses strong L DIRECTLY — no seeded 'stagnant' pick — so effectiveL (e1Regime.js:198,229, the wet-stagnant mixed hand-up) is NOT needed and is RESERVED for 2b-2b's wet-stagnant world. Clean split boundary.

LAB SEAM = FULL MIXED-DRIVERS FOLDER, PRODUCTION DISPATCH UNTOUCHED (Max's scope choice 2026-07-05; §5.5 no game port / no dispatch flip). A NEW lab 'Drivers → mixed lid (V2-2b-2)' folder with L / Φ / n / tidal(Io-ratio) sliders + an A/B flip (reusing the driverOv/_driverAbMode plumbing, mirroring #4-M + V2-2b-1) + a _lab API (setMixedDrivers / renderMixed) drives writeLidResponseSphere with a hand-set/slider E1 coordinate and swaps carrier.height into the render — a LAB-ONLY path. acceptanceCriteria.statement: THE PER-CENTER PIERCE BOOLEAN — the anti-mush lynchpin (gate-2 / §2.4 / delegable #2). For each seeded center p, PIERCE iff plumeStrength_p·Φ > Ybase(L) = Y0·exp(Y_K·L). The boolean is SHARP (a center is a shield OR it is not — no partial-pierce blend). Reproduce gate-2's calibration at pinned vectors: at the Tharsis coordinate 1-3 of the strongest centers pierce; at a Venus-strong coordinate ~0 pierce. Monotone correct-sign across a sweep: raising Φ or lowering L (within the mixed interior) does NOT DECREASE the pierce count; pierced centers emit PIERCE-family primitiveIds (shield/caldera), un-pierced strong-lid centers emit TENT-family (corona/tessera). The pierce count is a step function of the boolean, never a continuous fraction.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: CENTER-ORGANIZED, NOT LATITUDE-BANDED (mirror V2-2b-1 AC2/AC3 + §5.3 AC2/AC3). The mixed output is organized by the seeded upwelling centers, not by latitude: |corr(structureMask, the arm's-length squared-Gaussian center predictor rebuilt from the published centers)| stays plume-organized (>= 0.40, the #4b/V2-2b-1 bar) AND >> the latitude signal; and the falsifier varExplainedByLatitude = r²(U, sin²(+y latitude)) < varExplainedByCenter at every mixed sweep point. Placement keys off the center field (the composer's own 'lid:centers:' set), so a mixed world does NOT fall to sin²(lat) bands — the same regression the #4b/V2-2b-1 writers were built to escape, now guarded on the NEW mixed composition.

verifyVia.input: Headless vitest at N=1500: across the AC-PIERCE mixed sweep, compute |corr(structureMask, squared-Gaussian center predictor from the published centers)| and varExplainedByLatitude vs varExplainedByCenter at each point

acceptanceCriteria.statement: ANTI-MUSH ORDERING + EDIFICE BUDGET BOUND (§2.4 D1-MF1 fix / delegable #7 / §5.3 AC-ORDER-MIX). The shield-edifice HEIGHT contribution is bounded BELOW the inter-province floor gaps — INCLUDING magma's tall edifices (up to EDIFICE_HEIGHT=1.0), not just stagnant texture: assert max(edifice height contribution) < min(inter-province floor gap) so no landform can cross another province's floor. The tune re-tunes WHICH landform each center grows + HOW tall within its budget, never WHERE the province floors sit.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: ONE PRIMITIVE PER NODE — sharp province boundaries (§5.3 AC-MIX-DISCRETE; the direct anti-mush assertion). EVERY node's height derives from EXACTLY ONE primitive, keyed by the emitted primitiveId — measured ON primitiveId, NOT by height-array inspection (within-province BOUNDED-CONTINUOUS texture legitimately produces heights indistinguishable from a forbidden blend, so height inspection can't tell mix from mush; primitiveId can). Province boundaries are SHARP: adjacent nodes with different primitiveId show a discrete change of expression, not an averaged ramp between two primitives. The primitiveId histogram over a Tharsis-like world shows a small discrete set of populated ids (shield + preserved-plain + rift), not a smear.
